plot_policy: Set plot_detector_ids to all for a 2048-detector plotting array; simulation always covers the complete source grid.
raw_root_policy: Preserve all ROOT shards; never automatically delete.
exposure_policy: Sum replicate counts and acquisition durations per source; activity must agree. c_ij = n_ij / (summed acquisition_s * activity_bq).
resource_note: Full GATE production uses 1 CPU / 4G per shard worker, with 8 workers by default (32G aggregate). full_worker_walltime is passed by par_full.sh; confirm it is allowed by the general-compute partition. full_array_max_concurrent remains the configurable ceiling for the small heatmap array.
